title: California Attorney General asks FBI to investigate Newton

tellings.quote: On April 25th, 1951, he had the California Attorney General's office contact the FBI to look into Newton, questioning his claims of conducting secret government research and accusing him of being in on a hoax.

plain: On April 25, 1951, according to Michels, a man named JP Khan got the office of California's Attorney General, the state's top law officer, to ask the FBI, the US federal police agency, to look into a man named Silas Newton. Newton had claimed to be doing secret government research, and the request questioned those claims and accused him of being part of a hoax. Michels tells this from the FBI's own files on Newton, as a sign of how seriously officials took Newton's claims.
